## AG Mortgage Investment Trust, Inc. Schedules Third Quarter 2025 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 28, 2025 at 4:15 PM EDT


[PDF Version](https://www.mitt.tpg.com/node/13926/pdf)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 28, 2025-- AG Mortgage Investment Trust, Inc. (NYSE: MITT) (the “Company”) announced today that it will release third quarter 2025 financial results prior to market open on Tuesday, November 4, 2025. The Company will host a conference call to discuss the results on Tuesday, November 4, 2025, at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time.


To participate in the call by telephone, please dial (800) 343-5172 at least five minutes prior to the start time. International callers should dial (203) 518-9856. The Conference ID is MITTQ325. To listen to the live webcast of the conference call, please go to ****[https://event.on24.com/wcc/r/5118237/1491CC4C6366A98F6176976D1AD83C73](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.on24.com%2Fwcc%2Fr%2F5118237%2F1491CC4C6366A98F6176976D1AD83C73&esheet=54346815&newsitemid=20251028579161&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.on24.com%2Fwcc%2Fr%2F5118237%2F1491CC4C6366A98F6176976D1AD83C73&index=1&md5=adf5de126101dc64eabdabf4ce20b302) and register using the same Conference ID.


A presentation will accompany the conference call and will be available prior to the call on the Company’s website,[www.agmit.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.agmit.com&esheet=54346815&newsitemid=20251028579161&lan=en-US&anchor=www.agmit.com&index=2&md5=dfda68988108f095f19666fa0ee8e1f8) , under “Presentations” in the “News & Presentations” section.


For those unable to listen to the live call, an audio replay will be available on November 4, 2025 through 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time on December 4, 2025. To access the replay, please go to the Company’s website at[www.agmit.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.agmit.com&esheet=54346815&newsitemid=20251028579161&lan=en-US&anchor=www.agmit.com&index=3&md5=1a514edb7871bd8c8be47e7f21047c8c) .


**About AG Mortgage Investment Trust, Inc.**


AG Mortgage Investment Trust, Inc. is a residential mortgage REIT with a focus on investing in a diversified risk-adjusted portfolio of residential mortgage-related assets in the U.S. mortgage market. AG Mortgage Investment Trust, Inc. is externally managed and advised by AG REIT Management, LLC, a subsidiary of Angelo, Gordon & Co., L.P., a diversified credit and real estate investing platform within TPG.


Additional information can be found on the Company’s website at[www.agmit.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.agmit.com&esheet=54346815&newsitemid=20251028579161&lan=en-US&anchor=www.agmit.com&index=4&md5=f6c4b636343de9ae297955492a25234c) .


**About TPG Angelo Gordon**


Founded in 1988, Angelo, Gordon & Co., L.P. (“TPG Angelo Gordon”) is a diversified credit and real estate investing platform within TPG. The platform currently manages approximately $99 billion across a broad range of credit and real estate strategies. For more information, visit[https://www.tpg.com/platforms/tpg-angelo-gordon](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tpg.com%2Fplatforms%2Ftpg-angelo-gordon&esheet=54346815&newsitemid=20251028579161&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tpg.com%2Fplatforms%2Ftpg-angelo-gordon&index=5&md5=6543c390401d06c69130a124ce7a13ca) .
